'''Walter Samuel "Edy" Tavares''' (born March 22, 1992) is a Cape Verdean professional [[basketball]] player. Tavares is a member of the [[Cape Verde national basketball team]]. 

==Biography==
===Early life===
Tavares was discovered by a German citizen who was on vacation in Cape Verde in 2009.<ref>http://hoopshype.com/interviews/sierra/walter-tavares-the-biggest-unknown-in-the-draft Walter Tavares: The biggest unknown in the draft</ref>

===Professional Career===
Tavares has played with CB Gran Canaria since 2009.<ref>http://bleacherreport.com/articles/2089543-who-is-walter-tavares-meet-nba-drafts-mystery-7-footer Who Is Walter Tavares: Meet NBA Draft's Mystery 7-Footer</ref>  CB Gran Canaria announced on June 19, 2014 that Tavares, who is eligible for the [[2014 NBA Draft]], has re-signed with the club on a three-year deal.<ref>http://www.cbssports.com/nba/eye-on-basketball/24593213/draft-prospect-walter-tavares-signs-three-year-deal-with-gran-canaria Draft prospect Walter Tavares signs three-year deal with Gran Canaria</ref>
